# Workflow

Operations about workflows

## Retrieve all workflows

> Retrieve all workflows from your instance.

only.\n- `all`: Redact all executions (manual and production).\n\nWhen the instance has a redaction floor configured, the policy must be equal to\nor stricter than the floor. A policy weaker than the floor is rejected with 422\non create, and on update when it changes the stored policy; an unchanged\npre-existing below-floor policy is preserved (the floor is not applied\nretroactively).
